# metadata.validate_sidecar { #healpyxel.metadata.validate_sidecar }

```python
metadata.validate_sidecar(df, meta, strict=True)
```

Validate sidecar structure and return diagnostic metrics.

Performs comprehensive validation of the sidecar DataFrame against
expected HEALPix metadata: required columns, cell ID ranges, weight
validity in fuzzy mode, and source-to-cell mapping integrity.

## Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name   | Type               | Description                                                                                       | Default    |
|--------|--------------------|---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|------------|
| df     | pd.DataFrame       | Sidecar DataFrame with columns ``source_id``, ``healpix_id``, and optionally ``weight``.          | _required_ |
| meta   | HEALPyxelxMetadata | Expected HEALPix metadata for validation.                                                         | _required_ |
| strict | bool               | If True, raise ``AssertionError`` on validation failures. If False, return results with warnings. | `True`     |

## Returns {.doc-section .doc-section-returns}

| Name   | Type   | Description                                                                                                                                                                     |
|--------|--------|---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
|        | dict   | Validation results with keys: ``valid``, ``errors``, ``warnings``, ``n_rows``, ``n_unique_sources``, ``n_unique_cells``, and optionally ``weight_sum_min``, ``weight_sum_max``. |

## Raises {.doc-section .doc-section-raises}

| Name   | Type           | Description                              |
|--------|----------------|------------------------------------------|
|        | AssertionError | If ``strict=True`` and validation fails. |
